title: Mo Xiansheng's Bargaining Chip
next_chapter_hook: Before Mo Xiansheng finished speaking, a blood-colored command token in the Holy Sect envoy's sleeve had already lit up silently. Chen Ji's Tianji Record shuddered violently at the same instant—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had finally noticed everything here.

text.content: The burning heat in his sleeve almost seared through his skin. The Tianji Record Fragment twisted and burned like a living thing, golden runes frantically reorganizing in the void. As the words 'Don't come' still echoed in his ears, Chen Ji felt a tearing pain spread from his brow center through his limbs and torso—the backlash of prophecy, the sensation of Heavenly Fate Value visibly draining away.

dialogue.content: Brother… the Holy Sect wants… what's on you… run quickly…

text.content: The vision of blood resonance shattered like reflections in water. Chen Ji forced himself through the agony to open his eyes, his pupils reflecting a chaotic gold—a new prophecy taking shape. But just then, an aged yet familiar voice exploded in his mind: 'Enough, enough! Look any further and you'll only have death waiting!'

The first page of the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with blinding white light. Mo Xiansheng's illusory figure, condensed from remnant soul, stepped out from the pages. His withered palm pressed directly onto Chen Ji's brow center. A cool stream of power flooded in like tidewater, forcibly scattering the prophecy image that had been forming. Chen Ji groaned, blood dripping from his nostrils.

Rare urgency flickered across Mo Xiansheng's aged face, though his voice remained extremely low: 'How much Heavenly Fate Value remains? Tell me!' Chen Ji struggled to scan his consciousness—and found only twenty-three points left. His heart sank heavily. Twenty-three points could sustain at most four more prophecies.

Mo Xiansheng suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a狠厉 he had never shown before. 'I thought I'd have to wait for three more volumes, but I didn't expect you, boy, to burn the Tianji Record to this degree. Since the cards are already on the table, I'll tear this entire game apart with you!'

The moment his words fell, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly expanded, his originally illusory form solidifying tenfold. A brilliant golden light erupted from his chest, illuminating the entire ruined temple. Outside, the Holy Sect envoy's shocked howl came: 'Who's there?!'

Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and an intricate formation pattern spread across the void. At its center floated a completely golden command token, engraved with a soaring Kunpeng bird, beneath which were four archaic characters—'Patrol Heaven's Errand'.

dialogue.content: Imperial Decree—Patrol Kunpeng! You Holy Sect remnants, seeing this token is like seeing the Emperor himself. Dare you not kneel?

text.content: Golden light swept outward like a tide. The temple door exploded with a boom. The Holy Sect envoy stumbled back three steps, the composed arrogance on his face instantly crumbling, replaced by unimaginable terror. His two attendants knelt directly on the ground, trembling violently.

dialogue.content: I know what you Holy Sect scheming. Heavenly Fate Lock Key? What a fine Heavenly Fate Lock Key! You thought refining Chen Nian into a lock key, the Imperial Court would just sit by and do nothing?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang like a great bell, every word carrying overwhelming might. Chen Ji watched clearly—this was the true Mo Xiansheng, the one before whom even the Eye of Heavenly Dao had to show caution. The turmoil in his heart was forcibly suppressed, his expression returning to its usual water-like calm.

dialogue.content: I'll tell you truthfully—the Imperial Court's stance on the Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan has only two words—Extermination. How could such a heaven-defying object be allowed to be tainted by your evil cultivators? You've been plotting for centuries, but do you know the Emperor's bloodline long noticed?

text.content: The Holy Sect envoy's face had gone white as paper, his lips trembling as he tried to speak but couldn't utter a single word. Mo Xiansheng's words were like a massive hammer, shattering all his倚仗—their Holy Sect's greatest trump card was actually a path to death in the Imperial Court's eyes!

dialogue.content: Of course, I have no authority over Imperial Court affairs. But Chen Ji's matters, I can decide seven-tenths of.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng shifted his focus. That golden token floated slowly toward Chen Ji, hovering three feet before him. 'I can tell you where Chen Nian is being held. But the condition is—you must walk out of this forest alive.' His gaze fell on the Holy Sect envoy. 'As for them…'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng has already reversed the situation. The Holy Sect envoy is filled with fear. At this moment when Chen Ji holds the Imperial Decree token, facing this reversal of fortune, what choice will he make?

choices.text: Seize the moment to slap faces, wash away past humiliations
choices.description: Having endured hidden as a废物 persona until now, now that the enemy has shown cowardice, it's the perfect time to beat a drowning dog and vent pent-up grievances.
choices.visible_cost: Completely make enemies of the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Holy Sect loses face completely, reputation soars
choices.risk_hint: Cornered beasts may still have tricks, troubles may arise later

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, brushed the dust from his robes, a faint smile curling his lips. That smile, in the Holy Sect envoy's eyes, was more terrifying than any threat.

dialogue.content: Just now, sir said you'd take Chen to 'enjoy bliss'? I wonder if this 'bliss'… is the kind found in Holy Sect dungeons?

text.content: With each step Chen Ji took, the Holy Sect envoy retreated one step. That originally arrogant face had twisted into liver-colored rage. The surrounding air seemed frozen. The two attendants knelt on the ground, trembling, not daring to lift their heads.

choices.description: Playing weak to eat the strong is fundamental to survival. Revealing too much now would be inadvisable. Better to temporarily release them, to serve as future hidden pieces.
choices.visible_reward: Holy Sect becomes a usable chess piece
choices.risk_hint: Miss the golden opportunity, may leave regrets and troubles

text.content: Chen Ji收敛了his smile, retreated to Mo Xiansheng's side, and slightly clasped hands toward the Holy Sect envoy.

dialogue.content: Since it's a misunderstanding, clearing it up is fine. Sir came here on orders, Chen can understand. Please return, and convey Chen's greetings to the Holy Sect on my behalf.

text.content: These words made a flash of appreciation appear in Mo Xiansheng's eyes—this youth deeply understands the art of advancing and retreating. The Holy Sect envoy was overjoyed like receiving a pardon, scrambled out of the ruined temple, swearing never to set foot in this place again.

choices.text: Use the knife to kill, eliminate troubles forever
choices.description: With Mo Xiansheng here, it's the perfect opportunity to use Imperial Court power to uproot the Holy Sect completely. One effort, lasting peace, no lingering dangers.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul power
choices.visible_reward: Holy Sect forces suffer heavy blow
choices.risk_hint: Get drawn deeper into Imperial Court's chess game

text.content: Chen Ji said quietly: 'Sir, these people cannot be kept alive.' Upon hearing this, Mo Xiansheng laughed lightly, that laughter carrying a few traces of gratification.

dialogue.content: The youth is teachable. Since you've spoken, I'll clean this up for you—the Imperial Court kill order will spread across the world by tomorrow.

text.content: A flash of golden light, the Holy Sect envoy's scream cut off before it could even sound. Three bodies turned to ashes, leaving not a trace. Chen Ji watched this expressionlessly, his heart rapidly calculating—just how much time would this ruthless move buy him?

After the Holy Sect members had completely vanished, Mo Xiansheng recalled his token, his expression complex as he looked at Chen Ji. 'Your choices just now, I saw them all. Whatever you chose, I won't interfere. But there's one thing you must know right now.'

dialogue.content: I do know where Chen Nian is being held. But that place… even in my prime, I wouldn't dare tread lightly. If you want to rescue her, you must become stronger.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form began to fade, clearly the previous series of actions had consumed much of his power. 'The Imperial Decree token can only intimidate for a time. Behind the Holy Sect is Heaven—' he pointed upward, 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed you.'

Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that was an existence he currently couldn't contend with. Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his thoughts, a meaningful smile appearing on his aged face.

dialogue.content: Don't fear it. Though the Eye of Heavenly Dao is omnipresent, it cannot directly intervene in mortal affairs. It can only set schemes, can only guide. The reason you've walked to today is precisely because you've exceeded its expectations.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form grew fainter and fainter, but his final words burned like a brand into Chen Ji's mind: 'Remember, the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the weaker the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control grows. The day you gather all nine pages is when your true game against it begins.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng is about to dissipate. At this final moment, he will present you with an important choice regarding next steps.

choices.text: First consolidate cultivation, advance step by step
choices.description: Though the Holy Sect retreated, the Eye of Heavenly Dao has fixed its gaze on you. Reckless action will only expose more weaknesses. Better to hide and cultivate first.
choices.risk_hint: Younger sister suffers in the Holy Sect

text.content: Chen Ji said deeply: 'I need time.' Mo Xiansheng nodded. Before his remnant soul fully dissipated, a warm jade slip fell into his palm—a map to a certain secret realm.

dialogue.content: In three days, an ancient cultivator's ruins will open in the Northern Wasteland. There's the second page of the Tianji Record Fragment I prepared for you there… whether to go or not, you decide yourself.

choices.text: Immediately pursue, give them no breathing room
choices.description: While the Holy Sect hasn't recovered, take the initiative to intercept their messengers, disrupting the enemy's arrangements.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's location, get drawn into a greater vortex
choices.visible_reward: Gain Holy Sect intelligence, seize the initiative

text.content: A fierce gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: 'Don't give them the chance to send word back.' Mo Xiansheng愣了一下, then burst out laughing.

dialogue.content: Good! I haven't misjudged you! Since that's your choice, I'll help you one more time—thirty li ahead, they set up a teleportation formation. I can temporarily disrupt its operation.

text.content: Before his words finished, a token black as ink flew into Chen Ji's hand. 'This token can manifest my remnant soul once more, only once. Where to use it, think clearly yourself.'

Mo Xiansheng's form completely dissipated, leaving only a faint scent of ink in the air. Chen Ji stood alone in the center of the ruined temple, the two tokens—one gold, one black—in his palm, heavy as grasping an entire world. He closed his eyes. Chen Nian's muffled voice echoed in his mind once more—'Don't come, it's a trap'.

A trap, is it… Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold smile flickering in his gaze. If it truly is a trap, then he'll rip it open from the bottom. He took a deep breath, stored the two tokens in his sleeve, and strode out of the ruined temple. Outside, the night was deep, and on the distant horizon, the lights of the three major sects still shone brilliantly.

But in Chen Ji's eyes, those lights were no longer unreachable stars. He looked down at his own hand—on the back of his hand, a golden thread as fine as hair was slowly spreading. That was the mark left by the Tianji Record's burning, proof of his game against the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

Suddenly, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve heated up again. Chen Ji frowned, took it out to examine—and on the fragment, the originally blurry outline of the third page had become clearer. A line of tiny characters appeared: 'Kunpeng Token, Imperial Bloodline, Patrol Under Heaven—Token holder may enter the 'Tianji Pavilion' once.'

Chen Ji repeated these three words softly. The name Tianji Pavilion, he had glimpsed in some ancient texts—it's where the Imperial Court stored research materials from generations of Tianji Record guardians. Within might lie the key to breaking through his cultivation bottleneck. Yet the Pavilion's exact location has never been known. Only those holding the Kunpeng Token can find the entrance.

This night, Chen Ji was destined to have no sleep. He sat cross-legged beneath an ancient pine, the Tianji Record Fragment spread before him, his brow furrowed. Heavenly Fate Value had only twenty-three points remaining. Chen Nian's situation was dire. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze was like芒刺在背, while the threats from the three major sects and Holy Sect loomed近在咫尺.

But the corner of his mouth curved into a faint smile. The bigger the chess game, the more valuable the pieces. He closed his eyes, beginning to deduce every possible variation for what came next in his mind—this was his greatest strength, his greatest reliance for surviving to today.

In the distant sky, the first light of dawn was about to break. Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the brightening sky. Behind him, the golden patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment grew increasingly brilliant, as if something was slowly awakening. He himself couldn't say clearly whether it was hope, or a greater crisis.

Regardless, he had no retreat. Before him lay dragon pools and tiger dens; behind him, abyss. And he—the废物 servant of the Tianqing Sect, holding the incomplete Tianji Record that even the Eye of Heavenly Dao must fear—was step by step walking toward the center of the chess game that belonged to him.

Morning wind brushed past, carrying distant shouts and killing sounds. Chen Ji's brow moved—the direction of the Northern Wasteland. The day the ancient cultivator's ruins would open had actually been moved up by three full days. He rose abruptly. The Imperial Decree token in his sleeve trembled slightly, as if responding to some kind of summons. The gears of fate had already begun to turn.

But just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled. A cold-to-the-extreme consciousness pierced through the void, directly stabbing into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That consciousness held no emotion whatsoever, only pure examination and… a barely perceptible trace of appreciation.

These two words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's heart. He猛地抬头, gazing toward the dawn-colored sky—in that layered void, as if an invisible eye was piercing through, watching him. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—it had already seen everything that happened here.
